title: Assassin's Legacy: Echoes Through Time
description: A Minecraft mod inspired by Assassin's Creed, bringing historical eras and parkour stealth gameplay into a modern-day storyline.
body:
**Assassin's Legacy: Echoes Through Time** brings the iconic equipment and atmosphere of the Assassin's Creed universe into Minecraft. This mod is designed for players who want to bring historical flair and deadly precision to their world through high-quality models and themed content.

⚔️ _**Current Features**_

- **Assassin & Templar Arsenal**: Wield iconic weapons including the Hidden Blade and other period-specific armaments.
- **Specialized Equipment**: High-quality models for Assassin robes.
- **Themed Content**: Includes unique decorative blocks, paintings, and custom music to set the historical atmosphere.
- **World Generation**: Discover new themed structures and historical outposts scattered across your world.
- **New Entities**: Encounter Templar mobs, providing a new challenge for your survival world.
- **Legendary Artifacts**: Discover ancient secrets like the Artifact of Eden (currently decorative).

🛠️ **_Technical Details_**

- **Multi-language Support**: Full translations for English, Russian, and German.
- **Future-Ready**: Built on a solid foundation, with more complex RPG systems currently in active development.
- **Core Requirement**: This mod strictly requires [MHSCore](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mhscore) mod to function.

🧩 **_Why Download Assassin's Legacy?_**

If you're looking to start your own brotherhood or simply want some of the most detailed historical gear available for Forge, this mod provides the perfect starting point. It transforms the visual and combat feel of the game without breaking the core Minecraft experience
